title: MLA 的两种展开
note_on_kind: 标准代码章（非 primer）：走 implementer 精简版 + lint_fidelity 全链。配对 primer = ch24（注意力变体数学：MHA/GQA/MQ 与 MLA 低秩压缩的数学已在 ch24 立，本章只做代码落地，不重推数学）。本章把 L0 的『模型层 MLA 框』打开：同一个 MLA 注意力层，prefill 段把 576 维潜向量上投影成 128 头完整 K/V 按 MHA 算（算力友好），decode 段把 q 先乘进潜空间、576 维当单头 MQA 算（带宽友好）——同一数学、两种算法、同一次前向里混批分流；再讲 MLA 层自报的特形 KVCacheSpec 怎么驱动 hybrid 组化（一池多组），收在 DSV4 第三代（上下文压缩 compress_ratio=4 + fp8_ds_mla 584B 布局）。indexer/稀疏注意力机制归 ch26，量化数学归 ch27，MoE 拼装归 ch28。
hook_suggestion: 「ch24 的数学说 MLA 把每 token 的 KV 压到 576 维潜向量——但注意力要的是 128 个头各自的 K 和 V，512 维潜向量怎么变出 128×(128+64) 的 K 和 128×128 的 V？答案藏在源码里：同一层有两条相反的展开路线——prefill 把潜向量『上投影』成完整 K/V 再做标准 MHA（kv_b_proj，算得多、读得少时划算），decode 反过来把每个头的 q 『吸收』进潜空间、576 维当单头 MQA 做、输出再上投影（W_UK/W_UV 两份重排权重副本常驻）。两条路线在**同一次前向**里按 token 分段执行——谁在什么时刻划的这条线？划错了会怎样？KV cache 只存 576 维，那 prefill 要用的完整 K/V 是从哪冒出来的、爆不爆显存？」（从 Part VI hook『Attention 是插座不是实现』+ 本章 introduces『MHA 展开 vs MQA 吸收/hybrid 组化』+ deepread/model-sample why_chains[10] 的 solution/cost 段提炼）

one_line: MLA 层把每 token KV 压进 576 维潜向量（vs DSV3 若 MHA 128×(192+128)=40960，71 倍），代价是注意力每次都要先『展开』：prefill（Sq/Skv≈1，算力富余）用 kv_b_proj 把潜向量上投影成完整 K/V 做标准 MHA——上投影会物化大张量，用 64k-token workspace 分块 + LSE merge 兜住；decode（Sq/Skv 小，带宽瓶颈）反向把每头 q 乘 W_UK^T 吸收进潜空间、576 维当单头 MQA 做、输出再乘 W_UV 上投影——W_UK/W_UV 以重排副本常驻（权重存两份）。两条数学等价的路线在同一次前向里按 token 混批分流：runner 按后端自报阈值把批重排成 decode→prefill、builder 数出 num_decode_tokens、forward_impl 在 token 维切一刀。MLA 自报特形 MLAAttentionSpec（num_kv_heads=1、head_size=576、fp8_ds_mla 时 584B/token），驱动 hybrid 组化一池多组（DSV4：压缩层/SWA 滑窗/indexer 三类子缓存同池）；DSV4 再加 compress_ratio=4 上下文压缩与统一 head_dim=512 记法。

stations.what: 选型三岔：DecoderLayer 装配时按 config 选注意力类——老 Deepseek（MHA）/ model_config.use_mla（DeepseekV2MLAAttention）/ 普通注意力。use_mla=is_deepseek_mla 且未禁用（config/model.py:L1791-L1792）——MLA 不是运行时开关，是装配期就定死的层类型

投影装配：fused_qkv_a_proj 一个 MergedColumnParallelLinear 同时做 q 侧下投影（hidden→q_lora_rank 1536）与 KV 侧压缩（hidden→kv_lora_rank+rope 576）；再配 q_a_layernorm/q_b_proj（q 低秩链）、kv_a_layernorm、kv_b_proj（512→128×(128+128) 上投影）、o_proj——低秩链在模型层就是六块标准积木

Wrapper 装配：投影打包成 MLAModules 注入 MultiHeadLatentAttentionWrapper，内层构造 MLAAttention 插座（prefix=…attn、kv_b_proj 引用一并交接——吸收重排要靠它拿权重）。插座 __init__ 断言后端 is_mla、注册 static_forward_context（mla_attention.py:L516-L518）

权重吸收重排（装配收尾，一生一次）：process_weights_after_loading 把 kv_b_proj 权重转置拆成 W_UK(512,N,128)/W_UV(512,N,128)，重排成 W_UV(N,512,128) 与 W_UK_T(N,128,512) 两份 bmm 副本常驻——prefill 走原 kv_b_proj、decode 走副本，同一份权重两种形状存两份（显存代价明码标价）
KV spec 自报：get_kv_cache_spec 报 MLAAttentionSpec(num_kv_heads=1, head_size=kv_lora_rank+qk_rope_head_dim=576)——潜向量不拆 K/V、单『头』；cache_dtype_str 原样透传（fp8_ds_mla 等特布局的字节账在 spec 侧算）

spec 收集与 hybrid 组化（启动期）：runner.get_kv_cache_spec（gpu_model_runner.py:L7800-L7832）遍历 static_forward_context 逐层收 spec → get_kv_cache_groups 四级分流（全同 spec 一组 / 全同 token 槽数一组 / DSV4 grouped 多组 / 页大小归一多组）。DSV4 实测：压缩层 MLAAttentionSpec(compress_ratio=4) + SWA 子缓存 SlidingWindowMLASpec + indexer cache 同池分组——ch14 的『一组一管理器』在 MLA 侧的兑现

每拍批重排：_may_reorder_batch 在 _prepare_inputs 前把持久批排成 decode→short_extend→long_extend→prefill 四区（backends/utils.py:L665 的互斥划分+换位）；threshold 取全部 KV 组 builder 自报的最小值（L7220-L7238）——FlashMLA 报 128『小 prefill 也走 decode 路径』、FA-MLA 报 512
builder 分流：MLACommonMetadataBuilder.build 调 split_decodes_and_prefills（decode_threshold=reorder_batch_threshold）数出 num_decodes/num_decode_tokens——批已被第 7 站排好，这里只找边界线在哪一行 token

外层前向：q 低秩链（fused_qkv_a_proj→split→q_a_layernorm→q_b_proj→view[Sq,N,P+R]）、KV 侧 split [512,64]+kv_a_layernorm 只打 kv_c、RoPE 只作用 rope 段（q[...,128:] 与 k_pe；nope 段不旋转——低秩可吸收的前提）、indexer 位（稀疏归 ch26）→ 交 mla_attn(q, kv_c_normed, k_pe)
写腿：impl.do_kv_cache_update 把本步新 token 的 576 维潜向量（kv_c_normed+k_pe 拼接）照 slot_mapping 散写进分页 cache——MLA 的 cache 里自始至终只有潜向量，没有任何完整 K/V
分流决策：num_mqa_tokens = attn_metadata.num_decode_tokens；num_mha_tokens = q.size(0) − num_mqa_tokens——token 维切一刀（批已重排：前段 decode/短 extend、后段 prefill），两条数学等价的路线就此分岔

MHA 展开腿（prefill 段）：kv_b_proj 把新 token 潜向量上投影成 per-head K/V（W_UK/W_UV 在此用原形状）→ prefill 后端算新 token 段；有历史上下文时 _compute_prefill_context（L2301）按 64k workspace 分块 gather 潜向量→上投影→算一块，merge_attn_states 按 LSE 精确合并——上投影大张量永不整段物化

MQA 吸收腿（decode 段）：torch.bmm(q_nope, W_UK_T) 把每头 q 的 nope 段乘进潜空间（L888）→ 与 rope 段拼成 [B,N,512+64] → impl.forward_mqa 以单 KV『头』的 MQA kernel 直接读分页 cache（L919）→ _v_up_proj 乘 W_UV 上投影回 V 维（L949）——576 维 cache 不动，权重跟着 q 走

key_classes.name: DeepseekV2MLAAttention
key_classes.responsibility: 模型侧 MLA 层装配者（DSV2/V3/V3.2 通用）：装六块投影积木（fused_qkv_a_proj 或 kv_a_proj_with_mqa / q_a_layernorm / q_b_proj / kv_a_layernorm / kv_b_proj / o_proj），打包 MLAModules 交给 Wrapper；V3.2 稀疏变体在此挂 Indexer（机制归 ch26）。选型由 DecoderLayer 三岔决定（L1233-L1237）。

key_classes.name: MultiHeadLatentAttentionWrapper
key_classes.responsibility: MLA 外层（@PluggableLayer.register('multi_head_latent_attention')——OOT 平台可整体替换的后门）。forward 做全部『展开前的预处理』：q 低秩链、KV 压缩+解耦 RoPE、然后交内层插座；o_proj 收尾。本章站 9 的舞台。

key_classes.name: MLAAttention
key_classes.responsibility: MLA 内层插座（nn.Module+AttentionLayerBase）：__init__ 选 MLA 后端家族（断言 is_mla）并装配第二套 prefill 后端；forward 写 KV（do_kv_cache_update）+ 调 forward_impl；process_weights_after_loading 做吸收重排；get_kv_cache_spec 自报特形 spec。两种展开的分岔点（num_mqa/num_mha）长在它的 forward_impl 里。

key_classes.name: MLACommonImpl / MLACommonBaseImpl
key_classes.responsibility: decode 后端共享基类：MLACommonBaseImpl 提供 dense-MHA prefill（_compute_prefill_context 分块循环 + forward_mha），MLACommonImpl 加 forward_mqa 抽象（FlashMLA/FlashInfer-MLA/Triton-MLA 等子类各自实现 decode kernel）。『两种展开』的前半段（吸收 bmm、上投影）在插座公共代码，后半段（kernel）归后端子类。

key_classes.name: MLAPrefillBackend（家族）

why_chains.decision: MLA 三代演化：KV cache 只存压缩潜向量；prefill/decode 两种相反的展开策略（MHA 展开 vs MQA 吸收）；DSV4 再上上下文压缩+fp8_ds_mla 自定义布局
why_chains.old_design: MHA/GQA：每 token 缓存 K、V 各 num_kv_heads×head_dim。DSV3 若 128 头 MHA，每 token 每 layer 需 128×(192+128)=40960 元素；Llama-70B GQA（8 KV 头×128 维）也要 2048。KV cache 总量是长上下文并发的第一瓶颈——PagedAttention（分页）只解决碎片与共享，不降低每 token 总量。
why_chains.pain: 长上下文批量并发的显存天花板：KV cache 装不下 → 要么砍 batch 要么砍上下文。DSV2 论文（arXiv:2405.04434，mla_attention.py:L28-L29 引用）把 KV 低秩压缩进潜空间。
why_chains.solution: DSV2/V3 世代（vllm/model_executor/layers/attention/mla_attention.py）：cache 只存 kv_lora_rank(512)+qk_rope_head_dim(64)=576 元素/token/layer（header 数学文档 L17-L100：Sq/Skv 比值决定路径、W_DQ/W_UQ/W_DKV/W_UK/W_UV 矩阵账本 L45-L70）；prefill（Sq/Skv≈1）compute-friendly MHA 路径——kv_b_proj 把潜向量上投影成完整 K/V 再标准 attention（forward_mha 调用点 L820-L829）；decode（Sq/Skv 小）data-movement-friendly MQA 路径——q 侧先乘吸收权重进潜空间、576 维当 MQA 做、输出再上投影（forward L601 内 num_mha_tokens/num_mqa_tokens 分流 L771-L772，吸收 bmm L860+——同一前向内 prefill/decode token 混批分流，比 v0.21 的两条独立 forward 更优雅）；过程权重存重排副本 W_UK/W_UV（process_weights_after_loading L994-L1040，split 在 L1033）；get_mla_dims 兼容统一 head_dim 与分离字段两种记法（L1501+）。DSV4 第三代（vllm/models/deepseek_v4/attention.py）：统一 head_dim=512 语义、fp8_ds_mla UE8M0 块缩放 uint8 布局 584B/token（448 NoPE+128 RoPE+8 scale，vllm/v1/kv_cache_interface.py:L409-L413）、compress_ratio=4 上下文压缩（仅 C4A 层带 indexer 选 top-k，attention.py:L207-L213、L277-L297）、输出侧 o_lora_rank/o_groups 低秩（L200-L262）、alignment 576B 页对齐（L663-L674）；DSV3.2 稀疏 MLA 656B 布局（kv_cache_interface.py:L414-L416）；IndexCache 缓存 indexer 打分结果跨轮复用（attention.py:L677+ DeepseekV4IndexerCache）。

def forward(
        self,
        positions: torch.Tensor,
        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
        llama_4_scaling: torch.Tensor | None = None,
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        q_c = None
        kv_lora = None

        if self.q_lora_rank is not None:
            assert self.fused_qkv_a_proj is not None, (
                "fused_qkv_a_proj is required when q_lora_rank is not None"
            )
            assert self.q_a_layernorm is not None, (
                "q_a_layernorm is required when q_lora_rank is not None"
            )
            assert self.q_b_proj is not None, (
                "q_b_proj is required when q_lora_rank is not None"
            )

            qkv_lora = self.fused_qkv_a_proj(hidden_states)[0]
            q_c, kv_lora = qkv_lora.split(
                [self.q_lora_rank, self.kv_lora_rank + self.qk_rope_head_dim],
                dim=-1,
            )
            q_c = self.q_a_layernorm(q_c)
            q_proj_layer = self.q_b_proj
            q_proj_input = q_c
        else:
            assert self.kv_a_proj_with_mqa is not None, (
                "kv_a_proj_with_mqa is required when q_lora_rank is None"
            )
            assert self.q_proj is not None, (
                "q_proj is required when q_lora_rank is None"
            )
            kv_lora = self.kv_a_proj_with_mqa(hidden_states)[0]
            q_proj_layer = self.q_proj
            q_proj_input = hidden_states

        kv_c, k_pe = kv_lora.split([self.kv_lora_rank, self.qk_rope_head_dim], dim=-1)
        kv_c_normed = self.kv_a_layernorm(kv_c)
        # Add head dim of 1 to k_pe
        k_pe = k_pe.unsqueeze(1)

        q = q_proj_layer(q_proj_input)[0]
        heads = self.num_heads
        if self.dcp_q_replicate:
            heads *= q_proj_layer.group_size
        q = q.view(-1, heads, self.qk_head_dim)

        if self.rotary_emb is not None:
            q[..., self.qk_nope_head_dim :], k_pe = self.rotary_emb(
                positions, q[..., self.qk_nope_head_dim :], k_pe
            )

        if self.indexer and self.is_sparse and not self.skip_topk:
            self.indexer(hidden_states, q_c, positions, self.indexer_rope_emb)

        if llama_4_scaling is not None:
            q *= llama_4_scaling

        q_dcp_replicated = None
        if self.dcp_q_replicate:
            q_dcp_replicated, q = q, q_proj_layer._local_view(q)

        attn_out = self.mla_attn(
            q,
            kv_c_normed,
            k_pe,
            output_shape=(hidden_states.shape[0], self.num_heads * self.v_head_dim),
            q_dcp_replicated=q_dcp_replicated,
        )

        if self.g_proj is not None:
            attn_out = attn_out * self.g_proj(hidden_states)[0].sigmoid()

        return self.o_proj(attn_out)[0]

embed_excerpts.what: 文件头数学文档·动机：Sq/Skv 比值决定用 compute-friendly 还是 data-movement-friendly——『同一数学、两种算法』的总纲
embed_excerpts.code:
MLA has two possible ways of computing, a data-movement friendly approach and a
compute friendly approach. We generally want to use the compute friendly
approach for "prefill" (i.e. the ratio Sq / Skv is relatively large, often near
1) and the data-movement friendly approach for "decode" (i.e. the ratio
Sq / Skv is small, often near 0).

NOTE what we deem small and large is currently determined by if it is labelled
prefill or decode by the scheduler, but this is something we should probably
tune.

Main reference: DeepseekV2 paper, and FlashInfer Implementation
(https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.04434 and https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/551).

        # the bmm's in 16-bit, the extra memory overhead of this is fairly low
        kv_b_proj_weight = get_and_maybe_dequant_weights(
            self.kv_b_proj, out_dtype=act_dtype
        ).T

        if self.dcp_q_replicate:
            # qrep wired here: validate unsupported decode backends once.
            assert self.q_pad_num_heads in (None, self.num_heads), (
                "DCP query replication is unsupported on head-padding MLA "
                "backends (q_pad_num_heads)."
            )
            if (
                self.is_aiter_triton_fp4_bmm_enabled
                or self.is_aiter_triton_fp8_bmm_enabled
            ):
                raise NotImplementedError(
                    "DCP query replication is not implemented for the aiter "
                    "FP4/FP8 MLA BMM paths."
                )

        assert kv_b_proj_weight.shape == (
            self.kv_lora_rank,
            self.num_heads * (self.qk_nope_head_dim + self.v_head_dim),
        ), (
            f"{kv_b_proj_weight.shape=}, "
            f"{self.kv_lora_rank=}, "
            f"{self.num_heads=}, "
            f"{self.qk_nope_head_dim=}, "
            f"{self.v_head_dim=}"
        )

            self.kv_lora_rank,
            self.num_heads,
            self.qk_nope_head_dim + self.v_head_dim,

            [self.qk_nope_head_dim, self.v_head_dim], dim=-1
        )

            from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.quark.utils import (
                quark_quantize_weight_to_mxfp4,

            # Convert from (L, N, P) to (N, L, P)

    kv_lora_rank: int
    qk_nope_head_dim: int
    qk_rope_head_dim: int
    v_head_dim: int


def get_mla_dims(model_config: ModelConfig) -> MLADims:
    hf_text_config = model_config.hf_text_config

    # Check if this is a DeepseekV4 config (uses unified head_dim + rope_head_dim)
    if hasattr(hf_text_config, "compress_ratios"):
        # DeepseekV4 style config: unified head_dim with rope_head_dim
        head_dim = hf_text_config.head_dim
        rope_head_dim = hf_text_config.qk_rope_head_dim
        return MLADims(
            q_lora_rank=hf_text_config.q_lora_rank,
            kv_lora_rank=head_dim,
            qk_nope_head_dim=head_dim - rope_head_dim,
            qk_rope_head_dim=rope_head_dim,
            v_head_dim=head_dim,
        )

    # DeepseekV2/V3 style config

def determine_chunked_prefill_workspace_size(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> int:
        scheduler_config = vllm_config.scheduler_config
        cache_config = vllm_config.cache_config
        model_config = vllm_config.model_config

        chunked_prefill_workspace_size = min(
            # Try for 8 full length request or at least 4 pages per-request
            max(
                8 * model_config.max_model_len,
                4 * scheduler_config.max_num_seqs * cache_config.block_size,
            ),
            # For long-context models try not to over-allocate limiting
            # kv-cache space, limiting it to 64k tokens,
            # which would result in the workspace being:
            #   2*(576)*(64*1024) = 144mb
            # (assuming 576 MLA head dim, and fp16)
            # which would result in up-projected context being
            #   2*(192*128)*(64*1024) = 3gb
            # (assuming 192 QK head dim, 128 heads, and fp16)
            64 * 1024,
        )

        # Enforce that we enough for at least 1 page per request
        chunked_prefill_workspace_size = max(
            chunked_prefill_workspace_size,
            scheduler_config.max_num_seqs * cache_config.block_size,
        )

        return chunked_prefill_workspace_size

        self,
        q: torch.Tensor,
        kv_c_normed: torch.Tensor,
        k_pe: torch.Tensor,
        kv_c_and_k_pe_cache: torch.Tensor,
        attn_metadata: MLACommonMetadata,
        k_scale: torch.Tensor,
        output: torch.Tensor,
        output_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        assert attn_metadata.prefill is not None
        assert self.dcp_world_size != -1

        assert prefill_metadata.prefill_backend is not None

            q = q.to(prefill_metadata.q_data_type)

        has_context = prefill_metadata.chunked_context is not None
        assert output_scale is None or not has_context, (
            "Fused FP8 output is only wired for the non-chunked-context path"
        )

            -1, self.num_heads, self.qk_nope_head_dim + self.v_head_dim
        )
        k_nope, v = kv_nope.split([self.qk_nope_head_dim, self.v_head_dim], dim=-1)
        k = self._concat_k_nope_k_pe(k_nope, k_pe)

        if use_fp8_prefill:
            k = k.to(prefill_metadata.q_data_type)
            v = v.to(prefill_metadata.q_data_type)

        output_prefill = prefill_metadata.prefill_backend.run_prefill_new_tokens(
            q=q,
            k=k,
            v=v,
            return_softmax_lse=has_context,
            out=(
                output.view(-1, self.num_heads, self.v_head_dim)
                if output_scale is not None
                else None
            ),
            output_scale=output_scale,
        )

        if has_context:
            assert prefill_metadata.chunked_context is not None
            suffix_output, suffix_lse = output_prefill
            if self.dcp_world_size > 1:
                context_output, context_lse = (
                    self._context_parallel_compute_prefill_context(
                        q,
                        kv_c_and_k_pe_cache,
                        attn_metadata,
                        k_scale=k_scale,
                        dcp_world_size=self.dcp_world_size,

                )

                    q, kv_c_and_k_pe_cache, attn_metadata, k_scale
                )

            suffix_output = suffix_output[..., : self.v_head_dim]

            output = output.view(-1, self.num_heads, self.v_head_dim)
            merge_attn_states(
                output=output,
                prefix_output=context_output,
                prefix_lse=context_lse,
                suffix_output=suffix_output,
                suffix_lse=suffix_lse,
                prefill_tokens_with_context=prefill_metadata.chunked_context.prefill_tokens_with_context,

            assert isinstance(output_prefill, torch.Tensor)

            output_prefill = output_prefill.flatten(start_dim=-2)

def split_decodes_and_prefills(
    common_attn_metadata: CommonAttentionMetadata,
    decode_threshold: int = 1,
    require_uniform: bool = False,
    treat_short_extends_as_decodes: bool = True,
) -> tuple[int, int, int, int]:
    """
    Assuming a reordered batch, finds the boundary between prefill and decode
    requests.

    The batch is expected to be ordered as:
        decode → short_extend → long_extend → prefill

    Args:
        common_attn_metadata: CommonAttentionMetadata object containing the
            batch metadata.
        decode_threshold: The maximum query length to be considered a decode.
        require_uniform: If True, requires that all decode requests have the
            same query length. When set, some queries may be considered prefills
            even if they are <= decode_threshold, in order to ensure uniformity.
        treat_short_extends_as_decodes: If True (default), short extends
            (query_len <= threshold but still prefilling) are counted as
            decodes. If False, they are counted as prefills.

    Returns:
        num_decodes: The number of decode requests.
        num_prefills: The number of prefill requests.
        num_decode_tokens: The number of tokens in the decode requests.
        num_prefill_tokens: The number of tokens in the prefill requests.
    """
    max_query_len = common_attn_metadata.max_query_len
    num_reqs = common_attn_metadata.num_reqs
    num_tokens = common_attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens
    query_start_loc = common_attn_metadata.query_start_loc_cpu

    if (
        max_query_len <= decode_threshold
        and (not require_uniform or decode_threshold <= 1)
        and treat_short_extends_as_decodes
    ):
        return num_reqs, 0, num_tokens, 0

    query_lens = query_start_loc[1:] - query_start_loc[:-1]
    if query_lens[0].item() > decode_threshold:
        # first request is not decode, so no decode requests
        return 0, num_reqs, 0, num_tokens

    if require_uniform:
        # check if we are in a padded uniform batch; this is used for full-CGs, some
        # requests may have a query length of 0 but since they are padding its fine
        # to treat them as decodes (ensures num_decodes matches the captured size)
        if treat_short_extends_as_decodes and torch.all(
            (query_lens == query_lens[0]) | (query_lens == 0)
        ):
            return num_reqs, 0, num_tokens, 0  # all decodes
        is_prefill = query_lens != query_lens[0]
    else:
        is_prefill = query_lens > decode_threshold

    if not treat_short_extends_as_decodes:
        assert common_attn_metadata.is_prefilling is not None
        is_prefill |= common_attn_metadata.is_prefilling

    if not torch.any(is_prefill):
        return num_reqs, 0, num_tokens, 0

    first_prefill = is_prefill.int().argmax(dim=-1).item()
    num_decodes = first_prefill
    num_prefills = num_reqs - num_decodes
    num_decode_tokens = query_start_loc[first_prefill].item()
    num_prefill_tokens = num_tokens - num_decode_tokens
    return (num_decodes, num_prefills, num_decode_tokens, num_prefill_tokens)

def reorder_batch_to_split_decodes_and_prefills(
    input_batch: "InputBatch",
    scheduler_output: "SchedulerOutput",
    decode_threshold: int = 1,
) -> bool:
    """
    Reorders the batch to split into prefill and decode requests; places all
    requests with <= decode_threshold tokens at the front of the batch.

    The batch is reordered into 4 regions:
        decode:        (num_scheduled <= threshold AND is not prefilling)
        short_extend:  (num_scheduled <= threshold AND is chunked prefilling)
        long_extend:   (num_scheduled > threshold AND is chunked prefilling)
        prefill:       (num_computed == 0)   # First chunks

    Returns:
        True if the batch was modified, False otherwise.
    """
    num_reqs = len(input_batch.req_ids)
    num_scheduled_tokens = [
        scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens[id] for id in input_batch.req_ids
    ]
    num_scheduled_tokens_np = np.array(num_scheduled_tokens)
    num_computed_tokens_np = input_batch.num_computed_tokens_cpu[:num_reqs]
    num_prompt_tokens_np = input_batch.num_prompt_tokens[:num_reqs]

    has_context = num_computed_tokens_np > 0
    is_below_threshold = num_scheduled_tokens_np <= decode_threshold
    done_prefilling = num_computed_tokens_np >= num_prompt_tokens_np

    # Mutually exclusive categories (exactly one True per request):
    # 1. No context yet -> prefill
    # 2. Has context, above threshold -> long_extend
    # 3. Has context, below threshold, still prefilling -> short_extend
    # 4. Has context, below threshold, done prefilling -> decode
    is_pure_prefill = ~has_context
    is_long_extend = has_context & ~is_below_threshold
    is_short_extend = has_context & is_below_threshold & ~done_prefilling
    is_decode = has_context & is_below_threshold & done_prefilling

    # Desired order: decode → short_extend → long_extend → prefill
    req_regions = np.zeros(num_reqs, dtype=np.int32)  # 0 = decode by default
    req_regions[is_short_extend] = 1
    req_regions[is_long_extend] = 2
    req_regions[is_pure_prefill] = 3

    num_decodes = int(is_decode.sum())
    num_short_extends = int(is_short_extend.sum())
    num_long_extends = int(is_long_extend.sum())
    num_prefills = int(is_pure_prefill.sum())

    target_regions = np.repeat(
        [0, 1, 2, 3],
        [num_decodes, num_short_extends, num_long_extends, num_prefills],
    ).astype(np.int32)

    needs_swap = req_regions != target_regions

    if not needs_swap.any():
        return False

theory: 每 token KV 账（数字例，配 ch24 primer）：DSV3 若 128 头 MHA，每 token 每 layer 缓存 128×(192+128)=40960 元素；MLA 只存 kv_lora_rank+qk_rope_head_dim=512+64=576（≈71 倍压缩）；Llama-70B GQA（8 KV 头×128 维×2）=2048（MLA 约 3.6 倍于 GQA 的节省）。注意：q 侧低秩（q_lora_rank=1536）是算力/参数账，不进 cache——cache 只省 KV 侧。另 MLA cache 是『单头』：num_kv_heads=1，比 GQA 的 8 头还少一层维度。

吸收的数学（结合律，本章核心推导）：attention score 的 nope 段 = q_nope·k_nope = q_nope·(W_UK^T·c) = (q_nope^T·W_UK^T)^T·c——乘法结合律让『先上投影 K 再点积』与『先把 q 乘进潜空间再点积』结果相同；输出侧同理 o = attn_out·W_UV。decode 侧选后者：每步只需把 [B,N,128] 的 q 变 [B,N,512]，而 cache 里的 576 维潜向量一行都不用动、也不用为 128 头物化 K。代价：W_UK/W_UV 以 bmm 副本存两份（mla_attention.py:L1094-L1096），且 q 侧每步多乘一次。

Sq/Skv 代价模型（两腿选择依据，文件头 L13-L21）：prefill 时 Sq/Skv≈1（新 token 多、历史少）——上投影 K/V 的算力被大量 query 摊薄，走 compute-friendly MHA；decode 时 Sq/Skv≈1/上千（每步 1 个新 token、历史全量）——瓶颈是把 KV 从显存搬进计算单元的字节数，576 维 MQA 只搬一份潜向量，走 data-movement-friendly 吸收。定性量纲：MHA 腿读字节 ∝ N·(P+R)·Skv（128 头全展开），MQA 腿 ∝ (L+R)·Skv（单份潜向量）；FLOPs 反向（L=512 > P=128，每 query-token 多算）。

chunked prefill workspace 账（源码注释原话，mla_attention.py:L1808-L1823）：workspace = min(max(8×max_model_len, 4×max_num_seqs×block_size), 64×1024) token；按 576 维 fp16 算 workspace 2×576×64×1024 ≈ 144MB；若不 chunk、全量上投影则 2×(192×128)×64×1024 ≈ 3GB——21 倍差距，这就是必须分块的原因。分块正确性靠 merge_attn_states：softmax 分块合并的精确恒等式（max 平移 + exp 加权归一，与 ch20 primer 的 online softmax 同一手法的块间推广），两块的 LSE 合并出与整块算完全一致的输出。

reorder threshold 的工程含义（flashmla.py:L120-L121 注释 'process small prefills with decode pathway'）：FlashMLA 把 ≤128 token 的 chunked-prefill 尾段也划进 MQA 段（FA-MLA 更激进=512）——这些段按 MHA 展开算力不划算（query 太少摊不动上投影），按吸收走单份潜向量更便宜；阈值是后端经验值（注释 'TODO(matt): tune this'），runner 取全部组的最小值统一执行（gpu_model_runner.py:L7220-L7238）。

fp8_ds_mla 字节账（flashmla_sparse.py:L64-L84 注释 + kv_cache_interface.py:L409-L416）：DSV4 每token 584B = 448B fp8 NoPE + 128B RoPE（64 个 bf16，**不量化保精度**）+ 8B scale（7 个 ue8m0 + 1B pad）；DSV3.2 = 512B fp8 NoPE + 16B（4 个 fp32 scale）+ 128B RoPE = 656B。对照 bf16 576×2=1152B：DSV4 布局 ≈2 倍压缩。alignment=576（FlashMLA 打包）/512（FlashInfer #44577）是页对齐口径、不是每 token 字节数。

compress_ratio=4 存储账：storage_block_size = block_size // compress_ratio（kv_cache_interface.py:L403-L405）——每 4 个 token 才占 1 个存储块位，cache 总量÷4；代价是读写都过 DeepseekCompressor（compress→norm→RoPE→store 融合核）且 indexer 只对压缩后的候选选 top-k（机制归 ch26）。注意 head_size 保持语义值 512、字节在 real_page_size_bytes 特算——『语义维数』与『物理字节』分离记账。

两条数值路径的等价性边界：MHA 腿与 MQA 腿数学等价的前提是 nope 段无 RoPE（RoPE 旋转是逐 token 对角阵，不可与 W_UK 交换——所以 RoPE 只打 rope 段、解耦存放，mla.py:L201-L203 是这个数学约束的代码化身）。这解释了『为什么 head_dim 要拆 nope/rope 两段』（v2 ch28 theory 的解耦 RoPE 维度账在 v0.27.1 仍然成立，锚点换成 mla.py:L189-L203）。
